note: Names, descriptions and grades are shown as PlayStation publishes them (as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase). Every guide below is written in the author's own words; the 'sources' beside each guide name where its facts come from — a source is cited, never copied.
sources: PSNProfiles / Exophase — official trophy names, descriptions and grades
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide (difficulty, time, missables, roadmap)

trophies.guide: The last trophy you will earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done, so there is nothing to hunt for it directly. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then the 100% checklist, then the stranger strands and clean-up.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy from one of the first missions of Chapter 1, Gone Fishing. It cannot be missed — just play the opening mission through to the end.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Pops when Chapter 1 ends. Story only and unmissable — finish the chapter's missions in order and it is yours.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Pops when Chapter 2 ends. Story only and unmissable — keep playing the main missions and it unlocks on its own.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Pops when Chapter 3 ends. Story only and unmissable — it comes with finishing the chapter.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Pops when Chapter 4 ends. Story only and unmissable — the last chapter trophy before the finale.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Pops for finishing the final mission — the only hidden gold in the list. Story only and unmissable. Keep a manual save before the final mission: there is no mission replay, so a save is your safety net.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It cannot be missed — play the mission and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy for The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 mission. It cannot be missed — finish the heist and it pops.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy for Child's Play, a Chapter 4 mission. It cannot be missed — complete the mission and it unlocks.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy for Headliners, a Chapter 4 mission. It cannot be missed — finish the mission and it is yours.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 mission. It cannot be missed — play the mission through.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy for Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 mission. It cannot be missed — finish the operation and it pops.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) appears after the story, but progress made earlier already counts, and nothing on it is missable. Expect roughly 100 hours after the credits; the checklist is closer to 60% true completion — 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals and 50 of 66 weapons.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts; any 250 of the 397 in the game count (300 are needed for 100%). Stunts build up naturally while driving and riding — chase jumps, near-misses and air time in free roam rather than grinding one spot.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Work down the activity list — races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, the shooting range, drone races, meditation, hunting and the rest — one go at each is enough.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Gold each challenge; a range's challenges share the same weapons, so learn one range's rhythm before moving on.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — one win at each of the 14 spots (all 42 races count toward 100%). Learn each course's line first; a win only needs the fastest run at that spot.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on offer; winning the same race twice does not count. Tick off a new race each time and keep a note of which you have won.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal texts you after a Chapter 1 mission and marks the spot with a purple icon — head there and out-fish him.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game, start to finish. Any arcade cabinet in Leonida counts.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final mission. Andy's strand runs through the story; keep taking his jobs when they appear and the last one pops the trophy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission. Take Kenton's jobs as they come up and the strand ends with this trophy.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final mission. His five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after a Chapter 2 mission and stay open after the story, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some strangers count — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete do; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not. Pick the counting strands and finish all their missions.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission. Work through Randy's jobs as they appear.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission. Work through Tyrone's jobs as they appear.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia. THE missable one: the first spot is offered at home in Chapter 1 and is gone for good after that chapter, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it — do it anyway to be safe. The last spot needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. 100% only asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so the Chapter 1 spot cannot cost you A Long Road.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His hunting quests start after Chapter 2 and are Jason-only; the exact animal is not confirmed yet.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets out of the 18 in the game. Cards are scattered across Leonida; finish any three full sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — any mix of Landmarks (31), Curiosities (35), Sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags. Photograph the world as you travel; the count climbs on its own.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges (70 count toward 100%). Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and more — pick the easy ones first and let the rest come.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build four stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Keep the wanted level alive between robberies — move fast from shop to shop and do not let the stars drop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them (200 of the 277 base models count toward 100%). Scan every new vehicle you see; the count grows fastest in traffic-dense Vice City.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Fill your Focus first, then trigger it with an assault rifle against a group.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a passenger jet parked at a boarding gate, take off and get about 1 km away.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: “Kinda hot in these Rhinos.” Steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs give you the Snap Gun for the back door — use it and stay out of sight.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape, out of 8. Vaults open up with an optional Chapter 4 mission and always bring 4 stars, so have a fast bike ready for the getaway.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. A bank vault job counts if you get away.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Clear the fog from the whole map; a plane is the fastest way to sweep the far corners.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang: one per gang, 9 gangs (all 39 operations count toward 100%). Hit one operation for every gang on the map.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: “Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.” The exact trigger is unconfirmed — neither PowerPyx nor GTABase has pinned it down yet. The description points to having a drink with the Ocean Beach view; try the beachfront bars.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: “Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.” Unconfirmed: the description points to driving out through the showroom window.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: “Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.” Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn, then lose the police.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: “A partnership with mass appeal.” Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia; working out together trains both.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: “Choices made (for better or worse).” 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. It builds up across everything you do — do not push toward the Irredeemable profile, it is permanent.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: “Second time's the charm.” The exact trigger is unconfirmed — neither PowerPyx nor GTABase has pinned it down yet. The wording suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: “What the hell just happened?” The exact trigger is unconfirmed. The wording points to witnessing something strange out in Leonida — keep your eyes open in odd corners of the map.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: “Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.” The exact trigger is unconfirmed. The description points to knocking someone down with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. It is a running total, and Yasmani pays the most — funnel your marked bills through him.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, as a running total. Normal shopping counts — clothes, weapons, food and everything else adds up.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: the 8 for sale, about $160,000 in total. The 4 story garages do not count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which Moses gives you in Chapter 2. You need free garage space for each one.
trophies.name: On the Spot
